title: Modine to Participate in Upcoming Oppenheimer Virtual Conference on May 5, 2026
summary: Modine (NYSE: MOD), a diversified global leader in thermal management technology and solutions, announced today that it will participate in the Oppenheimer 21 st Annual Industrial Growth Conference on Tuesday, May 5, 2026. Neil D. Brinker, Modine President and Chief Executive Officer, and Michael B. (Mick) Lucareli, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will participate in a virtual fireside chat during the conference on Tuesday, May 5, 2026, at 1:30 p.m. Eastern time (12:30 p.m. Central Time). Live webcasts of the event will be available in the Investor Relations section of Modine's website www.modine.com . Recordings of the events will be available for 365 days following the webcast. About Modine For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications.
